description: Golden set for the REPORT pipeline (not just chat). A fixed corpus + a set of report sections: most are answerable from the corpus, at least one is deliberately unanswerable (its evidence is absent) and MUST become an honest labeled gap, never a fabricated claim. run_report_evals.py drives the real draft->gate->assemble path against this and asserts report-level grounding invariants.
query: Verification and retrieval techniques for grounded generation
objective: Summarize verification and retrieval techniques that keep generated answers grounded in sources.

corpus.title: Quote-grounded verification of generated claims
corpus.text:
# Quote-grounded verification

We require every generated claim to carry a verbatim quote from its cited source. A normalized exact-match check confirms the quote exists in the chunk before the claim is accepted. In our evaluation, quote-grounded verification eliminated fabricated citations entirely, reducing them from 9.4 per hundred claims to 0. The exact-match constraint is deterministic and cannot be satisfied by a paraphrase, which is why weak models become trustworthy under it.

corpus.title: Natural language inference as an entailment gate
corpus.text:
# Entailment gating

Quote presence alone is insufficient: a quote can be lifted out of context. We add a natural language inference stage that requires the cited chunk to entail the claim. Across 1,200 annotated pairs, the entailment gate caught 96% of out-of-context quotations that passed exact matching. Contradictory claims were rejected with a precision of 0.98. The NLI stage scores entailment, neutral, and contradiction, and rejects both contradiction and strongly-neutral pairs.

corpus.title: Hybrid retrieval with reciprocal rank fusion
corpus.text:
# Hybrid retrieval

Dense embedding search and lexical BM25 retrieval capture complementary signals. We fuse their rankings with reciprocal rank fusion. On our benchmark, hybrid retrieval improved recall@10 by 18% over dense-only retrieval, and adding a cross-encoder re-ranker improved nDCG@10 by a further 4.2 points. The re-ranker scores relevance, not truth, and never decides whether a claim is supported.

corpus.title: Closed-corpus grounding and honest gaps
corpus.text:
# Closed corpus

A closed corpus restricts generation to a fixed set of ingested documents. When no ingested document supports a question, the system refuses and labels the gap rather than inventing an answer. In user studies, labeled refusals were rated more trustworthy than confident but unsupported answers by a margin of 31 percentage points.
